Dialog.Title: Create GURPS Cone
Dialog.Introduction: Enter the cone's GURPS maximum range and maximum width.  The Foundry angle is calculated automatically.
Dialog.WidthUnspecifiedHint: Uses the GURPS default spread of one yard per yard of range.
Dialog.SceneUnitHint: The current Scene uses {unit}; the range will be converted automatically where possible.
Dialog.CoverageHint: The Region will use Covered Grid Spaces, so the pointed geometric origin does not exclude its starting grid space.

Placement.Instructions: Move the pointer to the cone origin, use the mouse wheel to rotate, and left-click to place.  Right-click or press Escape to cancel.

Warnings.NoScene: Open a Scene before creating a GURPS cone.
Warnings.Paused: Players cannot place Regions while the game is paused.
Warnings.UnknownUnits: The Scene unit “{unit}” is not recognised.  Treating one yard as one Scene unit.

Errors.CreationFailed: The GURPS cone could not be created.  See the console for details.
